<p class="hero-subtitle">Systematic Trader and Macro Analyst · London</p>

I'm Mo Heidari, a systematic trader and macro analyst based in London. I trade US index markets with a rule-based process and follow the US economic cycle through Treasury yields, ISM surveys and other macro data. I hold an MSc in Financial Economics (Distinction) from City, University of London.
